checks.name: report_identity
checks.description: The report-facing product is populated and invoice UUIDs are complete and unique.
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT ScanmanInvoiceUUID) AS distinct_invoice_uuids, SUM(CASE WHEN ScanmanInvoiceUUID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_invoice_uuids FROM data_governance.scanman.scanman_workbench_report

checks.name: aging_dimension
checks.description: The governed aging dimension has five complete buckets.
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS aging_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT aging_bucket) AS distinct_buckets, SUM(CASE WHEN aging_bucket IS NULL OR sort_order IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomplete_rows FROM data_governance.scanman.scanman_aging_dim

checks.name: security_bridge_completeness
checks.description: Security bridge completeness is visible for release review.
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bridge_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN active_directory_users_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_user_keys, SUM(CASE WHEN project_number IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_project_numbers FROM data_governance.scanman.bridge_scanman_user_project_relationship

checks.name: refresh_audit
checks.description: The approved refresh audit exposes current source and report timestamps.
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS audit_rows, MAX(LastRefreshArizona) AS latest_report_refresh, MAX(LatestSourceRefresh) AS latest_source_refresh FROM data_governance.scanman.scanman_refresh_audit
